README: The tracked delivery plan for cloud journeys. Each status is a claim that src/release/acceptance.ts checks against this repository (test/acceptance-journeys.test.ts). There is no COMPLETE status. SYNTHETIC_PASS proves software behavior with fake engines; LIVE_PASS needs owner-authorized evidence naming the source commit, target, engine and outcome. Neither stands in for the other.

positive.title: AWS Terraform cleanup: approve under the cleanup domain, destroy exactly the proposal's addresses as APPLY after a targeted destroy plan as DISCOVERY, record evidence, and verify every deletion gone
the proposal lists exactly what this run created and the observation found present, keeps the state backend, the pilot identities and pre-existing resources, and hashes to its identity

denied.title: cleanup refuses, consuming nothing: a wrong target, an apply approval, an expired or replayed approval, an altered proposal, a proposal of another run or channel, and a second execution
the destroy plan must be exactly the approved list: a dependent the engine adds, an address the state no longer holds, or a non-delete action stops before any approval is consumed
a proposal is refused on ambiguous ownership (a partial apply, a planned resource the state never held) and on an inconclusive or changed observation
a wrong phrase at the cleanup approval or the removal signs nothing and runs nothing; an apply approval, a tampered proposal and a second run are refused before any phrase
forged inventory and evidence are rejected: a blueprint, observation or leftovers record with a wrong shape, a raw field or a claimed completion, and a proposal that was edited

interrupted.title: a partial or killed cleanup records its outcome and spends the proposal, and leftover verification reports deletion pending or still present, never complete
a kill switch during the cleanup stops the engine, records KILLED, and the proposal is spent; one appearing before the engine starts spends the approvals and destroys nothing

recovery.title: a restart or reconnect never executes a proposal twice: a held reservation refuses, verification is repeatable, and a lost response is reconciled from the ledger
a KMS key scheduled for deletion is DELETION_PENDING: not complete, not a leftover

live.blockedBy: Owner supervision and inputs (docs/act-pilot-apply.md, What the owner supplies): a pinned, enabled AWS contract with policyVersion, the DEV account, the S3 state bucket, the four web-identity roles and token files, approver public keys, and a person to run ./alz apply qualify with the CloudTrail attestation. Every step and proof of this row passes synthetically (fake engine, fake AWS CLI). The execute step alone becomes LIVE_PASS when that person runs one owner-supervised DEV apply, records it with ./alz apply record-live, and the owner commits the record and cites it as liveEvidence; the lifecycle report then marks the execute stage LIVE and is MIXED, never LIVE by declaration. A live cleanup of what that apply created needs the owner's separate authorization (docs/act-pilot-plan.md, Cleanup of pilot-created resources); the lifecycle report (./alz apply report) is SYNTHETIC until then and MIXED after it, never LIVE by declaration.
